elements.text: New Nationwide Blood Pressure Medication RecallGetty Images
If you take blood pressure medication—or know someone who does—there’s a new recall you’ll want to know about.
Inventia Healthcare first recalled certain lots of chlorthalidone tablets, which are used to treat high blood pressure,
Then, on September 3, the company initiated a separate recall involving an additional lot of the medication.

elements.label: the FDA classified the September recall as Class II

elements.text: the FDA classified the September recall as Class II
. (The June recall has also been classified as Class II).

Chlorthalidone is a diuretic, or “water pill,” that makes your kidneys shed excess water and salt. This helps lower high blood pressure and reduce water retention, lessening your chances of organ damage that could cause heart attack, heart disease, heart failure, stroke, kidney damage, or damage to your eyes that could impact your vision.
